'''Titan kantrey''' were aquatic crustaceans from [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. Their skin was covered with rough plates, used by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Mon Calamari Knights/Legends|Knights]] to craft their armor.
